title: ^ENGINEERING DESIGN PROJECT
description: Exposes problem situations and issues in engineering design similar to those encountered in industry through an extended team design project.
registration_restrictions:
Prerequisites: ECE 342 and (WR 227Z, 227HZ, 327 or 327H).
A minimum grade of C is required in ECE 342, WR 227Z, WR 227HZ, WR 327 and WR 327H.
